name: Ordered CommonGen
description: Ordered CommonGen is a benchmark designed to evaluate the compositional generalization and instruction-following abilities of LLMs by measuring whether generated sentences include given concepts in a specified order.
reputation: A niche but useful benchmark for compositional instruction-following, with some adoption in recent LLM evaluation work but not broad mainstream usage.
notes: Extends CommonGen by adding ordered coverage evaluation to assess instruction-following; reveals LLM biases and challenges in generating diverse outputs respecting concept order.
